tagline: A leading universal bank with strong operations in Brazil and Latin America
hero_kpi_rationale: Net Income is a key indicator of the bank's financial performance, reflecting a 24.1% increase in 2024 compared to 2023, demonstrating significant profitability growth.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: The bank's net income increased by 24.1% in 2024 compared to 2023
kpis.signal: Significant increase in net income in 2024

kpis.name: Efficiency Ratio
kpis.explanation: The ratio of non-interest expenses to revenue, measuring operational efficiency
kpis.description: The efficiency ratio decreased by 1.8 percentage points in 2024 compared to 2023, indicating better cost control

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: The bank's total assets increased by 12.3% in 2024 compared to 2023, rising from R$2,543.1 billion to R$2,854.5 billion
kpis.signal: Significant increase in total assets in 2024

kpis.name: Return on Average Equity
kpis.explanation: The bank's return on average equity
kpis.description: Return on average equity increased by 230 basis points in 2024 compared to 2023, reaching 20.9%
kpis.signal: Improved return on average equity in 2024

kpis.name: Dividend Payout
kpis.explanation: Total dividend and interest on capital payments to shareholders
kpis.description: Dividend and interest on capital payments increased by 10.5% in 2024 compared to 2023, with a payout ratio of 62.1%
kpis.signal: Significant increase in dividend payout in 2024

kpis.name: Non-Performing Loans Ratio
kpis.explanation: The ratio of non-performing loans to total loan portfolio
kpis.description: The non-performing loans ratio decreased by 0.2 percentage point in 2024 compared to 2023, to 3.5%, reflecting improved asset quality

kpis.name: Brazilian GDP Growth
kpis.description: Brazilian GDP increased by 3.4% in 2024, compared to 3.2% in 2023, with expected deceleration in 2025 due to higher interest rates
kpis.signal: Stable economic growth in Brazil in 2024

kpis.name: Inflation Rate
kpis.description: IPCA reached 4.8% in 2024, compared to 4.6% in 2023, with market prices up 4.9% and projected inflation of 5.7% in 2025
kpis.signal: Moderate inflation in Brazil with upward projections for 2025

ai_positioning.summary: There is no information available on the bank's artificial intelligence positioning in the 10-K analyzed
